summary: Tested new Employee Terminations section and Interview scheduling features. Found 1 critical bug: Interview Inbox API route ordering issue.

issues.description: Interview Inbox API route (/api/applicant-tests/interview-inbox) is being matched as /{test_id} parameter because it's defined AFTER the wildcard route in applicant_tests.py. This causes the endpoint to return 'Test not found' error instead of the interview inbox data.
issues.reproduction: curl -s https://curator-app-3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/applicant-tests/interview-inbox -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' returns {"detail":"Test not found"} instead of {"requests": [...]}

action_items: CRITICAL: Move the /interview-inbox route definition BEFORE the /{test_id} route in /app/backend/app/routers/applicant_tests.py (around line 1117). The route order matters in FastAPI - more specific routes must come before wildcard routes.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data (Test1 applicant test, admin account)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Employee Terminations section is working correctly - displays Active Employees list with Terminate buttons and Termination History. Interview Response page correctly shows error for invalid tokens. Interview Inbox button is visible and opens modal, but the modal fails to load data due to backend route ordering bug. The /interview-inbox route needs to be moved before /{test_id} in applicant_tests.py.

employee_terminations_section.details: Employee Terminations section displays in Team Management with Active Employees list and Termination History

terminate_buttons.details: Terminate buttons visible for active employees with data-testid='terminate-btn-{id}'

interview_response_invalid_token.details: Interview Response page shows 'Oops!' error for invalid tokens

interview_inbox_button.details: Interview Inbox button visible in Applicant Tests section with data-testid='interview-inbox-btn'

interview_inbox_modal.details: Modal opens but fails to load data due to backend route ordering bug

termination_api_endpoints.details: GET /history, POST /terminate, GET /{id}, DELETE /{id} all working correctly

rca_of_issue: The /interview-inbox route is defined at line 1117 in applicant_tests.py, but the /{test_id} wildcard route is defined at line 288. FastAPI matches routes in order of definition, so 'interview-inbox' is being captured as a test_id parameter. Fix: Move all /interview-inbox routes (lines 1117-1265) to before line 288 (before the /{test_id} route).
